business.name: Sri Lakshmi Mushrooms And Agrobusiness Pvt Ltd
business.legalName: Sri Lakshmi Mushrooms And Agrobusiness Private Limited
business.description: Leading organic mushroom production farm, biotechnology spawn laboratory, and commercial agribusiness consulting center in Bhadravati, Shivamogga, Karnataka. Specializing in high-yield oyster, milky, and medicinal mushroom cultivation, certified spawns, farm training, and project setup assistance.
business.shortTagline: Certified Organic Mushrooms, High-Yield Spawns & Commercial Cultivation Training in Karnataka

address.formatted: NH69, Vishweshwaraiah Layout Bypass Road, Jannapura, Bhadravati, Karnataka 577301, India

bookingSettings.confirmationPolicyText: All appointments are individually scheduled to give you hands-on personal guidance. Our farm coordinator confirms your slot via WhatsApp or phone.
bookingSettings.cancellationPolicyText: Please notify us at least 12 hours in advance if you wish to reschedule your visit or consultation.

services.name: Commercial Farm Tour & Facility Walkthrough
services.shortDescription: Guided tour of climate-controlled chambers, misting infrastructure & vertical growing racks.
services.fullDescription: Experience our full-scale organic mushroom cultivation setup in Bhadravati. Tour the vertical growing rooms, observe temperature and humidity control automation, and learn about the lifecycle of Oyster and Milky mushrooms with our lead agronomist.
deliverables: Full access to climate-controlled grow chambers
Demonstration of vertical rack system and misting technology
Direct Q&A with farm technical coordinator
Fresh mushroom harvest demonstration

services.name: Hands-on Cultivation Training & Inoculation Masterclass
services.shortDescription: Intensive practical training in substrate preparation, steam sterilization & spawn inoculation.
services.fullDescription: Comprehensive workshop for farmers, students, and new agribusiness entrepreneurs. You will prepare mushroom cultivation bags hands-on, learn paddy straw treatment, sterilization techniques, spawn mixing ratios, disease prevention, and post-harvest handling.
deliverables: Hands-on bag preparation & inoculation practice
Comprehensive Kannada & English cultivation guidebook
Complimentary 1kg laboratory-grade spawn bag to take home
Lifetime technical phone support for your first harvest

services.name: Commercial Agrobusiness Setup & Project Report (DPR) Consultation
services.shortDescription: Expert consulting on farm establishment, NABARD/NHB government subsidies, and project feasibility.
services.fullDescription: Planning to launch a commercial mushroom farm? Consult directly with our founders on farm architecture, insulated chamber engineering, HVAC climate control systems, Capex/Opex modeling, and state horticulture department subsidy documentation.
deliverables: Detailed Project Report (DPR) feasibility review
Government subsidy eligibility guidelines (NHB/MIDH/NABARD)
Civil layout and chamber ventilation design schematics
Buyback and regional market distribution advisory

services.name: Laboratory Mother Spawn Reservation & Quality Verification
services.shortDescription: Inspect and reserve first-generation pure grain spawn for Oyster & Milky varieties.
services.fullDescription: Visit our biotechnology laboratory to inspect mycelial density, reserve fresh master grain spawn batches, and learn proper spawn storage and multiplication procedures. Guaranteed high-yielding, contamination-free strains.
deliverables: Purity verification under laminar flow environment
Spawn batch viability and mycelium density certificate
Direct consultation on storage and humidity protocols
Priority batch allocation

services.name: Bulk Organic Harvest Procurement & Distributor Meeting
services.shortDescription: Schedule wholesale fresh or sun-dried mushroom pickups for hotels, markets & retailers.
services.fullDescription: Discuss recurring bulk supply contracts for premium grade fresh Oyster and Milky mushrooms, solar-dehydrated mushroom slices, and protein-rich mushroom powder for commercial food businesses and retailers.
deliverables: Sample tasting and grade inspection
Bulk pricing tier structure and delivery schedules
Organic farming certification documentation
Cold chain and packaging specification review

services.name: Spent Mushroom Substrate (SMS) & Bio-Compost Advisory
services.shortDescription: Guidance and procurement of enriched spent substrate for organic agriculture & vermiculture.
services.fullDescription: Spent Mushroom Substrate is an organic powerhouse enriched with fungal enzymes and residual mycelium. Meet with our soil specialists to assess bulk SMS orders for plantation crops, nurseries, and terrace garden enrichment.
deliverables: Substrate nutrient breakdown analysis
Application ratios for arecanut, coconut, and vegetables
Bulk tractor trolley loading logistics

reviews.author: Chandrashekar B.
reviews.text: Best place in Shivamogga district for authentic mushroom spawn and commercial training. Dr. Gowda explained the humidity requirements and substrate treatment with extreme clarity. My first oyster flush gave 1.4kg per bag!

reviews.author: Praveen Kumar
reviews.text: Visited the Bhadravati facility for our agri-entrepreneur project. The facility is immaculately maintained with modern misting systems. Very genuine team who supports farmers post-training.

reviews.author: Dr. Geetha Rao
reviews.text: Regularly purchase organic fresh milky mushrooms and mushroom powder from Sri Lakshmi Agrobusiness. Unmatched freshness and chemical-free quality. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Venkatesh Murthy
reviews.text: Very professional agrobusiness. They gave us complete insights into NABARD subsidy processes for setting up a 1-ton commercial mushroom unit.
